title: TemplateQuestionCreated.v1
description: Emitted when a new question is added to a pillar within a template draft.

templateId.description: ID of the template draft this item belongs to.
templateId.markdownDescription: ID of the template draft this item belongs to.

pillarSlug.description: URL-safe slug of the pillar this item belongs to.
pillarSlug.markdownDescription: URL-safe slug of the pillar this item belongs to.

questionId.description: Unique identifier of the created question.
questionId.markdownDescription: Unique identifier of the created question.

questionText.description: Display text of the created question.
questionText.markdownDescription: Display text of the created question.

questionType.description: Type identifier for the question, e.g. 'single-select', 'free-text'.
questionType.markdownDescription: Type identifier for the question, e.g. 'single-select', 'free-text'.

position.description: Zero-based position of the question within the pillar.
position.markdownDescription: Zero-based position of the question within the pillar.
